analysis_contract: Candidate document Recall@10/100, binary nDCG@10 and MRR@10 separately from packed gold-document coverage. Exact candidate selections/omissions and segment offsets/sizes; typed complete populations and raw attempt streams. Report per-arm process user/system CPU and peak RSS, native indexing_seconds and journal request microseconds; no unsupported query CPU attribution. Reproduction is not new questions.
commands: python3 enterprise-segmentation-v1/run.py --cache CACHE --beir BEIR --publication PUBLICATION.json --out FRESH_COLLECTION
python3 enterprise-segmentation-v1/analyze.py replay --cache CACHE --capture FRESH_COLLECTION/capture.json.gz --out FRESH_ANALYSIS.json
python3 enterprise-segmentation-v1/analyze.py controls --cache CACHE --capture FRESH_COLLECTION/capture.json.gz --out FRESH_CONTROLS.json
confirmation: UNMET_ELIGIBLE20: zero additional questions meet source/category/unambiguous full-gold-in-frozen500 eligibility. No smaller confirmation cohort.
publication_contract: Before querying provide --publication JSON with public_head, public_tree (40 hex), binary_identity {sha256,bytes}. Parent obtains clean anonymous exact-public-head binary after product publication and retains build provenance. This receipt is provenance input, not authentication.
recommendation_gate: No default changes. Recommend for this reduced corpus only with net packed coverage gain, ranking loss/failures/work disclosed. Heldout unmet prevents confirmation claims. No semantic sufficiency, official leaderboard, independent-company or monotonicity claim.
resource_contract: One elapsed 1800s collection deadline includes materialization, ingest/rebuild, queries and capture work; process group killed at remaining deadline. Each query 30s. Asset and corpus preparation inherits v2 compressed/cache/member bounds. No model, QMD, embedding, network or setup. Capture finalization may finish after collection deadline; disclose measured wall.
schedule: Pass, segmentation, budget, then original20 and eligible heldout20; fresh store per pass and segmentation, reuse only for second budget. All rows initialized before collection. A failing arm stops only its store; unfinished rows remain NOT_RUN. No retries or replacements.
